verification_log.title: Regression pin's substring probe contradicts its own false-positive claim
verification_log.reason: Claim: a `data-disabled-reason` attribute would land in the probed tag tail and fail the pin spuriously. Verified FALSE: Lustre SSR sorts attributes by name (server/build/packages/lustre/src/lustre/vdom/vattr.gleam:100 `list.sort` before merge); `data-disabled-*` < `data-testid` alphabetically, so it renders BEFORE the testid, outside the probe window (test splits on `data-testid="submit-application"` then probes to closing `>`). The comment's claim is accurate; no defect.

verification_log.title: JS-side consent gating now hinges on form.js init behavior asserted but not shown in this diff
verification_log.reason: Premise — recompute might key off the pre-existing disabled attribute — contradicted by the worktree: form.js:23-29 `__rtRecomputeSubmitDisabled` sets `submit.disabled` purely from `data-consent-blocked`/`data-preflight-blocked` markers; the consent IIFE (form.js:33-48) runs `refresh()` at init. Mechanism is documented verbatim in the PR body's Decisions section. Not a code defect; a packet-completeness request for content already provided.

findings.title: Fixtures-script mkdir -p has no automated regression pin (P3 dev tooling)
findings.evidence:
# fixtures/ is git-untracked, so a fresh checkout has no such directory —
# create it before cd or `set -e` aborts the run.
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"
cd "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"
findings.detail: No suite or CI step executes this script; verification was manual fresh-checkout sim. Blast radius is small: `set -e` makes any regression fail loudly at the next bug-hunt preflight, and the repo has no shell-test harness. Consistent with AGENTS.md named-regression philosophy.
findings.recommended_fix: Optionally add a pr-checks smoke step running the script from a clean temp copy; otherwise rely on the loud `set -e` failure at next preflight.
